group_outline_label.admin_behavior: Shows in the nested document outline; empty or absent uses the localized block type.
group_outline_label.catalog_behavior: Editor metadata only; public renderer intentionally ignores this attribute.

unsaved_changes.scope: Form fields and valid block editor changes in the current page instance.
unsaved_changes.signal: Browser beforeunload confirmation remains. Valid editor changes are also captured locally in sessionStorage for optional draft recovery; this is not a server autosave or background form submission.
unsaved_changes.submit: Guard is bypassed only for a normal form submit when all block editor hosts validate. Invalid editor submission remains guarded.
unsaved_changes.persistence: The explicit Blog/Page form submit remains authoritative. Session recovery is browser-local, per user and record, expires after 24 hours, and is restored only after user confirmation; it never saves or publishes to the server.
unsaved_changes.revision_history_fetch: D05=A (2026-11-17, David L. Almeida): same-origin POST/fetch for revision-list and item reads occurs only after an explicit, click-triggered user action. A chosen snapshot is restored in editor memory and still requires the explicit Blog/Page form Save; it is not an autosave.

client_draft_recovery.scope: Per authenticated admin user + editor context + post/page ID.
client_draft_recovery.capture: Valid editor changes only; recovery record plus up to five bounded temporary snapshots.
client_draft_recovery.retention: 24 hours; user confirmation required to restore.

patterns_persistence.decision: D08=A (explicit owner approval, superseding the prior B): document the existing behavior only; no new feature, endpoint, storage, or schema change authorized by this update.
patterns_persistence.scope: Private per-admin-user patterns, not global/shared by default. Available in the Blog and CMS page editor contexts.
patterns_persistence.authorization: Dedicated cms/block_pattern ACL is required. Reads require access to cms/block_pattern plus modify on the current context (blog/blog or cms/page); writes additionally require modify on cms/block_pattern. Owner ID comes from the authenticated session, not request data. Write endpoints require CSRF.
patterns_persistence.schema: Existing rms_cms_block_pattern table is defined in dev/install/sql/schema-complete.sql (and schema.sql). Runtime checks table availability; no dedicated incremental upgrade script or schema change is added by KZ-62.
patterns_persistence.storage_or_endpoint: Existing same-origin cms/block_pattern routes: list/get/save/rename/delete for Blog and CMS pages. Save validates/canonicalizes the document, rejects custom_js, limits documents to 4 MiB and 50 patterns per user; ownership is enforced by owner_user_id.

catalog_context_preview.constraint: No public preview endpoint, share token, draft URL, or network request added.
catalog_context_preview.next_design: Review a same-origin, authenticated, CSRF-protected preview path that invokes the server allowlisted renderer on validated draft JSON without writing a post or exposing a public bearer URL. Confirm ACL, origin and expiration rules first.

not_in_scope: server-side autosave, background form submission, or automatic publish
new draft-recovery storage or endpoints beyond the existing sessionStorage behavior documented above
new pattern endpoints, shared/global pattern storage, or new schema/migration changes
new revision writes; revision history reads and restore-to-editor remain explicit user actions and still require the explicit Blog/Page form save

features.editor_notes: Per admin user and saved post/page; browser-local notes, not sent to the server.
features.style_presets: Per admin user and editor context; browser-local presets, not shared or sent to the server.

decision_history.scope: Document existing F9-25 persistence behavior; no product code or schema feature added.
